what: Adds to 01267 (same fix, one more symptom): blaze-lints map_filter_map misses the iter_mut().for_each finding because items_send asks Type::impls_trait(Send) of the item type &mut u64, refused by the args.references_error() guard for its ReError region (crates/hir/src/lib.rs:5172). Checking only non-region errors (HAS_NON_REGION_ERROR), as 01267 says, fixes this too; close with 01267. From tests-misc-lints round 8b.

history.note: already in the tree with 01267: hir lib.rs Type::impls_trait folds ReError regions to erased before the references_error guard, so &mut u64 with an error region is solved modulo regions.
